thread:
sre-oncall: heads-up — our ap-south canary onboarding is failing. GPU nodes boot but remain in PROVISIONING for >10m. Seen after the keystore egress tighten rolled at ~15:05 UTC. INC-4321 created.
alex: looking now. are the keystore 502s correlated with natgw conntrack spikes?
maria: checking logs — keystore proxy shows a burst of keepalive failures around 15:06. nats show many half-open connections.
vikram: flat out: conntrack table went from 60% -> 98% in 3m. natgw metrics spiked at 15:04. likely the firewall rule change causing SYN backlog + keystore retries.
leah: @vikram do we have the rule id? I saw a minor deny-rollout earlier from eng-platform.
vikram: rule ID fw-rule-03b7. It added a tighter ephemeral port block for privnet egress. rollback request in progress.
sre-oncall: can we workaround by increasing keystore client timeout/retries so onboarding can complete? we need a short fix while rollback proceeds.
alex: I can patch the agent canary to use longer backoff (10s -> 30s) and fewer concurrent connections. Will push a canary config in 5m. @deploy-bot please hold unrelated rollouts.
deploy-bot: hold placed on non-critical canaries. rolling config patch to canary group only.
maria: log snippet from a stuck node:
```
2026-03-21T15:07:12Z keystore-client error: dial tcp x.x.x.x:443: i/o timeout
2026-03-21T15:07:12Z onboarding status: PROVISIONING -> heartbeat_miss
```
leah: ops-bot — can you increase conntrack table size on ap-south natgw pair as temporary mitigation?
ops-bot: raised request to infra runbook — conntrack bump to 262144 queued. ETA 12m.
vikram: rolling back fw-rule-03b7 now. will monitor for drop in SYN retries and keystore 502s.
sre-oncall: thanks. plan: 1) patch canary agent backoff (alex) 2) bump conntrack (ops-bot) 3) rollback fw-rule (vikram) 4) monitor onboarding rate + open INC updates. If onboarding doesn't recover in 30m we escalate to network oncall.
alex: patch deployed to canary at 15:19 UTC. early success: 2 of 3 canary nodes moved to ACTIVE.
maria: keystore 502s dropped after rollback. natgw conntrack % falling back to normal.
leah: note for postmortem: the firewall rule test missed ephemeral-crossflow cases. we'll add a gating test in staging to simulate high concurrent keystore handshakes.
vikram: documenting change in CH-512, tagging eng-platform + security for review.
sre-oncall: closing INC-4321 once all canaries are green and a final verification passes. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
